title: Whoop insights
description: A big display heading and paragraph, then a full-bleed track of tall 3:4 photo cards with 18px corners that snaps card by card with the next one peeking. Each card has a semibold title over a soft haze at the top and a round white plus button in the corner that fades a detail panel over the card (0.5s); small round dots follow the track.
notes: the cards' title haze uses the background colour, so titles stay readable over any photo
